verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor documents an MCP Server with over 40 specialised tools that lets external agents such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Copilot drive the editor [phaser-docs-13]. The editor page also describes programmatic scene operations such as creating particle emitters, reorganising layers and bulk-renaming objects [phaser-docs-29], which is a real but narrow form of editor automation. The probe suggests the official MCP actually rides the hosted Game Agent rather than the desktop editor [phaser-probe-rt-1], so how deeply it reaches into the editor is unclear. missing for 10: a documented editor plugin/extension API, user-authored editor scripts or custom tool panels, programmatic asset manipulation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
